subject: ClearWell: access gating kickoff — SSO/SCIM & IP/service-account plan
messages:
From: Chlo e Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearwell.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearwell.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWell access gating kickoff — SSO/SCIM & IP/service-account plan

Hi Sanjay / Claire —

Thanks again for the go-ahead on the pilot. Before we schedule the engineering kickoff, wanted to share a minimal access-gating checklist and confirm a few constraints from your side so CS and our infra team can size the runbook:

1) Identity provider: you mentioned Okta — can you confirm the org id and whether SCIM provisioning is enabled for third-party apps?
2) SAML details: will ClearWell manage the IdP metadata, or do you want Redwood to host the SP metadata and ACS endpoints?
3) IP allowlist: do you prefer we provide static egress IPs for SCIM and webhook calls, or will the firewall allow a continuous CIDR range from our Private deployment?
4) Service accounts: do you require a short-lived service account pattern (ephemeral keys) or a long-lived API key tied to a service identity?
5) Org policies & RBAC: any specific RBAC mapping (e.g., Okta groups -> ClearWell admin/dev/readonly roles) we should preseed in the SCIM mapping?

Attached are two small artifacts: an ACL diagram that maps intended service-account boundaries and a sample SCIM provisioning payload we use for testing.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick sync (30m) to lock down Okta metadata and IP requirements
- CS -> Eng MAM (mutual action plan) with milestones: SSO test, SCIM provisioning, service-account roll-forward, production cutover

Can you share your IT Ops contact and a couple of windows next week for the kickoff? If you prefer, we can do a short pre-read call with Ben (implementation lead) and Priyom (scim lead) on our side.

Thanks,

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

Attachment(s): clearwell_mam_acl_diagram.pdf, scim-provisioning-sample.json

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearwell.com>
To: Chlo e Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearwell.com>, IT Ops <it-ops@clearwell.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWell access gating kickoff — SSO/SCIM & IP/service-account plan

Chloe —

Thanks for the checklist — digging into the items:

- We use Okta (org: clearwell-prod). SCIM is enabled but gated; we need you to whitelist Redwood's SCIM POSTs on our side.
- For SAML, ClearWell prefers to manage the IdP metadata centrally (security team will provide the XML).
- Firewall: our perimeter team prefers to receive explicit outbound IPs to whitelist. Can you supply static IPs for the SCIM endpoint and the webhook callback?
- Service accounts: for the pilot we can use a long-lived API key scoped to a "redwood-provisioner" service identity; for production we'll move to short-lived k8s-style tokens.

IT Ops is cc'd (it-ops@clearwell.com) — Claire, can you work with them to schedule a 30m window? We're available Wed 26 Jul 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 27 Jul 14:00–16:00 PT.

Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Director, Platform Ops | ClearWell HealthTech
sanjay@clearwell.com

From: Chlo e Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClearWell access gating kickoff — SSO/SCIM & IP/service-account plan

Internal — forwarding ClearWell confirm. Key asks from the customer:

- Okta org: clearwell-prod; IdP metadata will be provided by their security team (they will host IdP XML).
- They require static outbound IPs for SCIM and webhook callbacks (their firewall team will whitelist).
- Pilot uses a long-lived API key scoped to service identity; prod will be short-lived tokens (we should document the migration path).

Please take action:
- Ben: can you confirm whether Redwood Hosted can provide a stable set of IP addresses for SCIM webhooks for pilot? If not, list possible technical options (NAT egress pool, region-specific EIPs, or recommend Priv deployment).
- Priyom: can you validate the sample SCIM payload attached and note any attribute-mapping quirks for Okta (e.g., multi-valued group -> our role mapping)?
- Monica: ownership on the mutual action plan timeline & which milestones we will include in the CS->Eng MAM doc.

I'll propose Wed 26 Jul 10:30 PT for the initial call unless they pick the earlier slot.

—Chloe

On Tue, Jul 25, 2028 at 11:03 AM Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearwell.com> wrote:
> Chloe —
> 
> Thanks for the checklist — digging into the items:...
> 
> Sanjay

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Chlo e Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 15:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClearWell access gating kickoff — SSO/SCIM & IP/service-account plan

Chloe / team —

Quick notes from infra perspective:

- Hosted API: we can allocate a stable NAT egress pool for SCIM calls in us-west-2 for the pilot (3 static IPs). I'll confirm exact addresses by EOD tomorrow. Downsides: those IPs are region-specific and not SLA-backed long term; for production recommend Private deployment or dedicated EIPs via our dedicated offering.
- Webhooks: same egress set can be used for callbacks, but we'll need to ensure TLS client cert pinning is compatible with their firewall rules.
- Service account pattern: we support long-lived API keys scoped to a service identity; we'll add a runbook step to swap to short-lived tokens (our token-rotation lambda) during prod cutover.

Priyom — please capture Okta mapping concerns and any schema validation we'll need to run before first push. Monica — once Ben posts the IPs, can you draft the MAM milestones and include a contingency: if firewall refuses NAT IPs, pivot to Private deployment recommendation.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Chlo e Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearwell.com>
Cc: Claire Huang <claire.huang@clearwell.com>, IT Ops <it-ops@clearwell.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearWell access gating kickoff — SSO/SCIM & IP/service-account plan

All — following the kickoff this morning (thanks everyone) here are the agreed technical checkpoints and owners. Posting this into thread for traceability.

1) IPs: Ben to provide 3 egress IPs (us-west-2 NAT pool) by 2028-07-30. ClearWell IT will whitelist those for SCIM POSTs and webhook callbacks.
2) SAML: ClearWell security will share IdP metadata XML to chloe@redwood.ai; our SP metadata lives at https://saml.redwood.ai/metadata/clearwell (we'll upload the ACS and certificate during the staging window).
3) SCIM mapping: Priyom will run a dry-run provisioning against ClearWell staging (attribute mapping: Okta groups -> role.claims with multi-value handling; note: we will map Okta 'external_id' -> user.external_id in SCIM).
4) Service accounts: Pilot will use a long-lived API key 'redwood-provisioner' scoped to SCIM:write. We will execute a token-rotation task in the prod cutover checklist.
5) Org policies & RBAC: Monica to document two roles for pilot (admin, read-only) and capture required Okta groups.

Attachments used during the call: clearwell_mam_acl_diagram.pdf, scim-provisioning-sample.json (copied).

Next milestone: staged provisioning test scheduled 2028-08-02 09:00 PT. Monica, can you send the MAM doc to the CS/Eng channel after you add the contingency notes? Sanjay / Claire — please confirm the staged test window and share the IdP XML as soon as available.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Platform Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
